I build reliable software and data-driven systems, from multithreaded network servers and distributed applications to full-stack platforms and intelligent navigation systems.

I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of California, Santa Cruz, and I am pursuing a master's degree in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. My current interests include machine learning, deep learning, software engineering, and cloud-based analytics.
